parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a folding knife, made of stainless steel. It is a sharp, metallic component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function of the knife. It can rotate or fold into the base body for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to fold into or extend out from the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the folding knife, made of wood. It provides grip and houses the rotating blade.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the handle for holding and controlling the knife. It also contains the pivot mechanism for the blade.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a stable grip while the blade rotates relative to it.
